core_idea: Edgar Family Heir Gregor is a Status Specialist / Support — **Sinking** stacker — payoff coins check **5+ Sinking**, so build the count before committing them. Sinking drains SP when the afflicted unit is hit. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 3 Sinking (max +2); Clash Power +1 per 3 Sinking (max +2). Support passive (**Endless Nightmares**) applies at **Combat Start** — set deployment with the intended ally before turn one.
playstyle_guide:
- **Endless Nightmares** fires at **Combat Start** — confirm roster and slot order pre-fight so the right ally receives the buff.
- Skills grant **Haste** — chain them when you need higher Speed next turn.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 3 Sinking (max +2).

**S1 — Sabre Slash** (BP 5, CP +6, 1 coin): rolls — low 5, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Coin Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- **Clash Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Scales Coin Power with Sinking stacks — apply liberally before committing (cap +2).

**S2 — Remise** (BP 4, CP +6, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- **Clash Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Wait for 6+ Sinking before this damage condition activates.
- If target has 5+ Sinking, gain 1 Haste next turn

**S3 — Nightmare Hunt** (BP 4, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- **Clash Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 3, max +3) — build stacks first.
- Absorb 10 Sinking from the target and gain 1 Plus Coin Boost and 1 Damage Up next turn. 50% chance to gain the above effects without absorbing Sinking

Combat passive — **Suffering**: Combat Start: 1 ally with the least SP loses 5 SP, then gains 1 Gloom DMG Up.
